cases.name: Sarah Hopson
cases.about: She went to  Tomball High School.
cases.narrative: On 11/13/2022, during a welfare check deputies found her body, wrapped up in carpet in a bedroom. Her toes, fingers and both ears had been cut off and were found in a clear freezer bag between her legs. She also had a large wounds to the right side of her head and forehead.

cases.name: Yuri Diana Barahona
cases.about:
She always called me by my nickname, she always called me Gordi," said Jose Barahona, the nephew of Yuri Barahona. 

Jose Barahona remembers his connection with his tia, the Spanish word for aunt, and how strong she was.

"She was like a second mother," Jose Barahona said. "She always tried her best and I'm happy for what she did for me."
cases.narrative: Her 10-year-old son found her body in the bathroom. She had two gunshot wounds just above her left eye.
